contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਸਲ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ ਦਾ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕੀਤਾ! (This week you practiced real translation!) Let's review everything.

Quick review: English follows Subject-Verb-Object order, Punjabi follows Subject-Object-Verb (Day 1). You translated sentences English-to-Punjabi (Day 2) and Punjabi-to-English (Day 3), always checking word order and gender agreement. You translated a complete short paragraph (Day 4). Read your paragraph translation from yesterday aloud, then answer the review questions below.
ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸ਼! (Well done!) You now understand a real structural difference between English and Punjabi, and you've practiced genuine two-directional translation, including at the paragraph level.

objectives: Recall the word-order difference between English and Punjabi
Demonstrate two-directional translation skill through review questions
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child read their own paragraph translation from Day 4 aloud.
3. Complete the cumulative review worksheet.
4. Discuss any mismatches or uncertain answers together before finishing.
5. Celebrate finishing a real week of translation practice, in both directions and at the paragraph level.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to use their Day 1-4 worksheets as a reference during review rather than working from memory alone
Ready for more: ask them to translate one more sentence of their own choosing, in either direction
This is a genuine milestone — real two-directional translation practice, matching the course's own 'translation practice' description
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. English follows Subject-Verb-Object; Punjabi follows Subject-Object-Verb. 2. 'The cat is small' = ਬਿੱਲੀ ਛੋਟੀ ਹੈ। 3. ਮੁੰਡਾ ਸਕੂਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। = The boy goes to school.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates the week's word-order concept and two-directional translation practice, matching the course's own 'translation practice' description end to end.

worksheet.title: Introduction to Translation Practice: Week 1 Review

generationData.instructions: Answer each question, drawing on everything you learned this week.

rows.problem: What word order does English follow? What about Punjabi?
Translate: 'The cat is small.' (ਬਿੱਲੀ = cat, ਛੋਟੀ = small)
